title: Cute, but falling apart - Make sure to have glue handy!
text: Cute, but falling apart - Make sure to have glue handy!. This Bofunice Merry-Christmas Burlap Party-Banner is cute but the set I received had nearly every letter falling off of its stocking. There was a ridiculous amount of glue on each stocking so why each letter was falling off is a mystery to me. I was able to remedy the issue with my own scissors and hot glue gun, but I shouldn't have had to. It should have come as described and pictured. But.. once I fixed it, the banner is cute and displayed well in my school bus. My kids got a kick out of so I suppose it was all worth it.
